name: drilldownLabel
label: Drill down label
description: Text visible at the tooltip to help user understand what will happen on click.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: When selected, enables an event handler to allow users to click a visualization value or section.

name: enableClickAndStay
label: Show selected data point
description: Use setting to visually show data point that has been selected/clicked on. Often can be used when the chart is acting as filter.

name: showDataTable
label: Show data table
description: Shows a table with chart and graph data for easier screen reader access.

name: yAxisStyle
label: Axis style
description: Style of the Y axis. Clean - Hides Y axis line, keeping just  axis values. No tick lines - Removes all tick marks from the Y axis. Standard - Adds a line and tick marks to the Y axis.

name: yAxisTitle
label: Y Axis Title
description: Title to display on the vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxisShowGrid
label: Y Axis - Show Grid
description: Adds grid lines to the chart.

name: xAxisTitle
label: X Axis Title
description: Title to display on the horizontal axis of the visualization.

name: xAxisWrapLabels
label: X Axis - Wrap labels
description: Wraps long element labels in the axis.

name: xAxisMaxLabelSize
label: X Axis Max Label Size
description: Maximum label size for the element names on the axis, in pixels.

name: showLegend
label: Show legend
description: Toggles the display of the legend on the visualization.

name: legendPosition
label: Legend position
description: Legend location relative to the chart.

name: showDataLabels
label: Show data labels
description: Displays the score for each data point.

name: dataLabelPosition
label: Data label position
description: Display data labels above, at the top, middle, or bottom of the bars.
